ReleaseNotes:
feat(firmware): add universal DMI, Serial & Windows Key Transfer engine
- Implement DmiExtractionService supporting ACPI MSDM, SMBIOS 2.x/3.x, NVRAM stores, and OEM signatures (Lenovo, HP, Dell, Apple, ASUS, Acer)
- Implement DmiInjectorService for non-destructive in-place injection with automatic ACPI checksum recalculation
- Add dual-chip Intel Flash Descriptor detection with guidance for ME-only dumps
- Integrate DMI file pickers, status bar, and actions into unified top container
- Add two-pane comparative table with icon-only clipboard copy and per-field injection
